notes: Use 履く (haku) specifically for items worn on the lower half of the body: shoes, socks, pants, skirts, and underwear.
This is distinct from 着る (kiru), which is used for items worn on the upper body like shirts, sweaters, and coats.
If you are putting on accessories like hats or glasses, use different verbs like 被る (kaburu) or かける (kakeru).
